stances.summary: Praises Skip Bertman's legacy building LSU athletics
stances.quote:
Louisiana lost a legend today.

Skip Bertman didn’t just build championship baseball teams—he built LSU athletics into a powerhouse and made generations of Louisianians proud.

Becky and I are praying for the Bertman family. God bless Coach Skip.

stances.summary: Criticizes progressive politicians as contemptuous of America
stances.quote:
Mayor Mamdani, Dr. El-Sayed and AOC want to beat the crap out of America.

They feel contempt for our country when they should feel gratitude.

stances.summary: Criticizes Democratic Party leadership as contemptuous of America
stances.quote:
The Graham Platner wing of the Democratic Party has utter contempt for America when it should have gratitude.

The only possible explanation has to be some real strong drugs.

stances.summary: Criticizes Democratic Party leadership as intellectually unserious
stances.quote:
The Graham Platner wing of the Democratic Party is the product of 50 years of high school civics being taught by football coaches.

At first, I thought they were just misinformed. Now I realize they’re serious—serious as an aneurysm.

stances.summary: Blames Senate for failing military funding and SAVE Act
stances.quote:
The Senate blows opportunities like it’s our job.

We had a shot to start reconciliation, strengthen our military and fight for the SAVE America Act—and we threw it away.

stances.summary: Criticizes postponement of budget resolution, pushes for SAVE America Act vote
stances.quote:
I did not—and do not—support the decision to postpone the budget resolution. I worked hard to get Leader Thune to agree to bring it up so we could move forward on the SAVE America Act, and I appreciate his willingness to do so.

I’m very disappointed we didn’t vote. We’ve talked

stances.summary: Opposes Senate recess, prioritizes legislative work
stances.quote:
I said I’d vote to stay through August recess and get our work done. I meant it. 

I voted NO on sending the Senate home. The American people sent us here to work for them, and I’m tired of Washington acting like getting the job done is someone else’s responsibility.

stances.summary: Urges senators to remain engaged in legislative work
stances.quote:
If you're confused, that means you understand the situation perfectly.

If senators start leaving, we can't get our work done and finish the job.

stances.summary: Expresses frustration with meetings, calls for voting action
stances.quote:
I'd rather have a back-alley colonoscopy than go to another meeting about the work we need to get done.

It's time to vote.

stances.summary: Advocates reconciliation process for Save America Act passage
stances.quote: Reconciliation is our best play to pass the Save America Act.

stances.summary: Commits to staying through recess to finish legislative work
stances.quote: If there’s a vote to stay here through August recess and finish the job, I’m voting yes.

stances.summary: Accuses Schumer of shutting down government to retain power
stances.quote:
The Graham Platner wing of the Democratic Party wants to put Chuck Schumer in a bathrobe, hand him a popsicle and send him to bed early.

So Schumer is shutting down the government to prove he is still in charge.

stances.summary: Celebrates Treasury blocking payments to deceased individuals
stances.quote:
The graveyard gravy train is finally over.

I spent years fighting to stop Washington from sending checks to dead people. Now, Treasury has blocked 4,900 payments worth $99 million.

Turns out checking for a pulse before cutting a check saves money. Duh.

foxnews.com/politics/tre

stances.summary: Supports voter ID requirements, criticizes Democratic opposition
stances.quote:
Most Americans agree: You should have to prove you are who you say you are when you vote. 

Last night, Senate Democrats blocked a simple voter ID bill. I voted YES.

This stuff isn’t radical. It’s common sense — and it’s how we earn back the American people’s trust.

stances.summary: Advocates for election integrity legislation via SAVE America Act
stances.quote:
You don't have to be a senior at Caltech to know the American people want election integrity.

This is why we need to pass the SAVE America Act.

stances.summary: Demands voter ID and Election Day voting, supports SAVE America Act
stances.quote:
We only need two things to restore confidence in our elections: Prove you are who you say you are, and have an Election Day—not an election month.

That’s what the SAVE America Act does. Let’s put it on the floor and pass it.

stances.summary: Characterizes Iran leadership as deceptive and dangerous
stances.quote:
The people running Iran learned to lie before they learned to talk.

They’re also crazy.

It’s like dealing with the Son of Sam or Charles Manson.

stances.summary: Calls for U.S. cyber retaliation against Iranian water system attacks
stances.quote:
Iran launched cyberattacks against one of our water systems in Michigan. 

We have cyber experts too.

We should hit them back. We should eat them up and spit the bones on the floor.

stances.summary: Claims U.S. has successfully weakened Iran
stances.quote: It’s not reported much, but we have really weakened Iran.

stances.summary: Supports Anna St. John's Fifth Circuit Court nomination
stances.quote:
Anna St. John is not a politician—she is intelligent, wise and patient.

She will represent Louisiana well on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and I’m proud to support her nomination.

stances.summary: Praises Coast Guard service and national security contributions
stances.quote:
Happy 236th birthday to the @USCG. Its brave men and women have defended our waters, answered the call in emergencies and protected our freedoms. 

America is safer because of them.

stances.quote:
1st Lt. Tyler Feehan and Pvt. Isabella Gonzales were only 25 and 19 years old. They represented the very best of who we are as Americans, and they made the ultimate sacrifice for our country.

stances.summary: Criticizes states for Medicaid fraud and mismanagement
stances.quote: If you say states aren’t cheating with Medicaid, you should check your pants because they’re probably on fire.

stances.summary: Praises law enforcement, calls for swift and severe justice
stances.quote:
I’m thankful for all the brave men and women across the Rapides Parish Sheriff’s Office, U.S. Marshals Service, and beyond who brought Deputy U.S. Marshal Hanson’s alleged killer behind bars.

stances.summary: Defends Todd Blanche's AG nomination, rejects opposition based on Trump representation
stances.quote:
Democrats say Todd Blanche cannot be Attorney General because he represented President Trump. 

The Constitution doesn’t require presidents to appoint their political enemies. Duh.

stances.summary: Praises deceased colleague Lindsey as influential and principled
stances.quote:
Lindsey was irreplaceable—a small earthquake who could sometimes be utterly and gloriously wrong, but impossible to stay mad at.

He left behind an improved world. I’m going to miss him.

stances.summary: Criticizes authoritarian discipline methods in schools
stances.quote:
I learned two things in high school civics: 

How government works—and to never help your buddy on an exam when your basketball coach has a paddle.
